en.title: Buddhist relics go on public display in Namsai
en.summary: The Golden Pagoda exhibition in Arunachal Pradesh is open for public viewing from November 14 to 20.

en.title: Delhi to host a cybersecurity and digital forensics conference
en.summary: NIELIT is bringing together specialists in cybersecurity and digital investigations in New Delhi on November 16 and 17.

hi.title: दिल्ली में साइबर सुरक्षा और डिजिटल फॉरेंसिक सम्मेलन

en.title: PIB explains the Lakhpati Didi initiative
en.summary: The backgrounder explains how the initiative supports women in self-help groups as they build sustainable sources of income.

en.title: PIB reviews private participation in India’s space sector

en.title: PIB outlines Adi Vaani’s work on tribal languages

en.title: Chhath Puja observances continue across India

en.title: Eklavya residential school students meet the President

hi.summary: एकलव्य मॉडल आवासीय विद्यालयों के मेधावी विद्यार्थियों ने 12 नवंबर की इस मुलाकात में हिस्सा लिया।

en.title: India wins the men’s under-19 Asia Cup

hi.title: भारत ने पुरुष अंडर-19 एशिया कप जीता

en.title: Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas programme includes a Mizoram museum opening

en.title: Stand-Up India scheme to continue

en.title: Credit guarantee fund for micro units will continue
